title: 第15章 小小插曲第16章 锁定目标
slug: 符心护剑重建三十三重天
content_zh:
接下来的几天，苏醒的生活规律得像一架精密的钟表。
每天六点起床，画符，发动天赋，吃饭，8点到个人训练室练习【白银锻体法】。
期间喝下一瓶活力药剂，中午2点吃饭，回房，画符，发动天赋，睡半小时，继续到个人训练室练习【白银锻体法】。
期间再次喝下一瓶活力药剂，下午7点结束训练，吃饭，回房，喝下一瓶活力药剂，画符，发动天赋，睡觉。
【白银锻体法】的难度远超他的想象。
它要求修习者像练习高难度瑜伽一样，连续做出十二个极其别扭的固定姿势，每一个姿势还必须配合截然不同的呼吸节奏。
比如需要浅吸三口再缓缓吐气一次，循环三次；又或者要求急速吸气四次，再悠长地一次吐尽，紧接着再次急吸四次……
其中难度对于苏醒这个现代宅男来说，简直难于上青天了，不过在【开心强记符】的强大加持之下，在第五天的时候，他终于成功了一次。
有了零的突破，后面的事情就顺利多了。
成功一次之后，身体仿佛逐渐熟练，苏醒给自己同时拍上10张【文昌符】和【开心强记符】，反正平均下来，天赋每次能复制出600倍的符箓。
熟练度开始飞速增长。
就在第六天，他一鼓作气地将【白银锻体法】技能等级提升到了十级！
也就是说，在第六天的时候，苏醒就已经完成了和店长罗天威的“对赌协议”
【基础剑术】-10级-动量增加40%
【挥砍】-10级-动量增加80%
【白银锻体法】-10级-体质+20-力量+10-精神+10
一种无比奇妙的感觉笼罩了他。
他能清晰地感知到自己变强了，但这种变强并非来自日积月累锻炼后肌肉纤维增粗、耐力提升的那种实在感。
更像是每提升一级【白银锻体法】，就仿佛有一套无形的“外骨骼装甲”
瞬间加载融合到他的身体上，骤然间体质、力量、耐力都获得了数据上的增长！

这几天的艰苦锻炼，他感觉自己的身体本身也有微弱的提升，但极其有限。
真正的巨变，完全来自于职业种子数据化后的恐怖加持。
他得出了一个让自己都咋舌的结论：他差不多变强了一倍，至少能干5个以前的自己。
以苏醒本身做标准，经过三年琦玉锻炼法的他，无论体质，力量应该都是高过一般人的。
而通过【白银锻体法】，苏醒觉得自身数据差不多增加了1倍多，但是不要忘了，通过【基础剑术】和【挥砍】的加成，他拿剑进行攻击的话，动量最多还能增加120%。
如果他此刻挥剑攻击，蕴含的冲击力将是过去的自己的4.4倍！
仔细计算一下，他只是把零阶白银职业的职业技能都练到10级，他的战斗力就是普通凡人的10倍，可见职业体系的强大。
第六天的晚上，苏醒正在自己房间里，正打算对着自己的天赋来一发的时候，他听见了敲门声。
苏醒带着疑惑打开了门，门前站着一个穿着和平饭店仆役装的年轻人，但是苏醒发誓，自己从来没有见过这个人。
“你就是苏醒吧，信哥托我给你带句话。”
年轻人抬起头，苏醒这才发现，这小子居然还打了个鼻钉。
“你是？信哥又是谁啊。”
“你管老子是谁，信哥，杨永信知道吧。”
content_en:
In the next few days, Su Xing's life was as regular as a precise clock.
Get up at six o'clock every day, draw talisman, activate talents, eat, and go to the personal training room at eight o'clock to practice [Silver Body Training Method].
During this period, I drank a bottle of vitality potion, had dinner at 2 noon, returned to my room, drew talismans, activated my talents, slept for half an hour, and continued to practice the [Silver Body Training Method] in the personal training room.
During this period, I drank a bottle of vitality potion again, ended the training at 7 pm, had a meal, returned to the room, drank a bottle of vitality potion, drew the talisman, activated the talent, and went to sleep.
The [Silver Body Forging Method] was far more difficult than he imagined.
It requires practitioners to perform twelve extremely awkward fixed postures in succession, just like practicing high-level yoga. Each posture must be matched with a completely different breathing rhythm.
For example, you need to take three shallow breaths and then exhale slowly once, cycle three times; or you need to inhale quickly four times, then exhale all in one long and long breath, and then inhale quickly four times again...
The difficulty level was simply beyond the pale for a modern otaku like Su Xing. However, with the powerful blessing of [Happy Strong Memory Talisman], he finally succeeded once on the fifth day.
With Zero's breakthrough, things will go much smoother later on.
After succeeding once, his body seemed to be getting more and more proficient. Su Xing took 10 pictures of [Wenchang Talisman] and [Happy Strong Memory Talisman] for himself at the same time. Anyway, on average, the talent can copy 600 times the talismans each time.
Proficiency begins to grow rapidly.
On the sixth day, he raised the [Silver Body Forging Technique] skill level to level ten in one go!
In other words, on the sixth day, Su Xing had completed the "gambling agreement" with the store manager Luo Tianwei.
[Basic Swordsmanship]-Level 10-Momentum increased by 40%
[Slash] - Level 10 - Momentum increased by 80%
[Silver Body Forging Method]-Level 10-Physique +20-Strength +10-Spirit +10
An extremely wonderful feeling enveloped him.
He could clearly feel that he was getting stronger, but this strengthening did not come from the solid feeling of thickening muscle fibers and improving endurance after long-term exercise.
It's more like every time you upgrade the [Silver Body Forging Technique], there is a set of invisible "exoskeleton armor"
Instantly loaded and integrated into his body, his physique, strength, and endurance suddenly increased statistically!
After these days of hard training, he felt that his body itself had slightly improved, but it was extremely limited.
The real great changes come entirely from the terrifying blessing of professional seeds digitized.
He came to a conclusion that shocked him: he had become almost twice as strong and could defeat at least five of his previous selves.
Based on Su Xing's own standards, after three years of Saitama's training, his physique and strength should be higher than those of ordinary people.
Through the [Silver Body Forging Method], Su Xing felt that his data had more than doubled, but don't forget that with the bonus of [Basic Sword Skills] and [Slashing], if he attacks with a sword, his momentum can increase by up to 120%.
If he attacks with his sword now, the impact will be 4.4 times that of his past self!
After careful calculation, he only trained all the professional skills of the zero-level silver profession to level 10. His combat power is 10 times that of ordinary mortals, which shows the power of the professional system.
On the night of the sixth day, Su Xing was in his room, and when he was about to try his talent, he heard a knock on the door.
Su Xing opened the door with doubts. Standing in front of the door was a young man wearing a servant uniform of the Peace Hotel, but Su Xing swore that he had never seen this person before.
"Just wake up. Brother Xin asked me to bring you a message."
The young man raised his head, and when he woke up, he realized that this kid actually had a nose nail.
"You are? Who is Brother Xin?"
"You don't care who I am, Brother Xin, Yang Yongxin should know."
